title: Despite, although and however
what: mixing up concession linkers ('despite of', 'although the rain', 'however' used like 'but' mid-sentence)
summary: These errors persist because the core meaning of concession is understood, but the grammatical structures differ. This leads to subtle imprecision, undermining the speaker's advanced command of English.
listenFor: Pay attention to whether you are using a full clause after 'although', a noun phrase after 'despite', and correct punctuation with 'however'.

contrasts.wrong: Despite of the recent downturn, investments are stable.
contrasts.right: Despite the recent downturn, investments are stable.

contrasts.wrong: Although the challenging circumstances, they met the deadline.
contrasts.right: Although the circumstances were challenging, they met the deadline.

contrasts.wrong: The proposal was ambitious, however it gained approval.
contrasts.right: The proposal was ambitious; however, it gained approval.
contrasts.note: 'However' is a conjunctive adverb, requiring stronger punctuation like a semicolon.

contrasts.wrong: Despite of the fact that he disagreed, he supported the decision.
contrasts.right: Despite the fact that he disagreed, he supported the decision.
contrasts.note: 'Despite' does not take 'of', even with 'the fact that'.

contrasts.wrong: She felt exhausted, although her presentation was flawless.
contrasts.right: She felt exhausted; however, her presentation was flawless.
contrasts.note: 'Although' connects clauses within a sentence; 'however' shows contrast between sentences.

contrasts.wrong: Although the heavy rain, the outdoor concert proceeded.
contrasts.right: Although it rained heavily, the outdoor concert proceeded.

drills: Despite the initial setbacks, the project ultimately succeeded.
Although the market is volatile, long-term prospects remain strong.
The team faced significant obstacles; however, they persevered.
Despite the late hour, she meticulously reviewed every document.
Although he had limited resources, his innovative approach yielded results.
The data was complex; however, the analysis provided clear insights.
Despite the widespread skepticism, the new policy proved effective.
Although the journey was arduous, the cultural experience was enriching.
Funding was scarce; however, they secured a crucial grant.
Despite the pressure, she maintained her composure during the negotiation.

probes.sentence: Despite of his extensive experience, he found the task difficult.
answers: Despite his extensive experience, he found the task difficult.

probes.sentence: Although the high cost, the company invested in new technology.
answers: Although the cost was high, the company invested in new technology.
Despite the high cost, the company invested in new technology.

probes.sentence: The meeting ran late, however all agenda items were covered.
answers: The meeting ran late; however, all agenda items were covered.
The meeting ran late, but all agenda items were covered.

probes.sentence: Despite of the fact that she was ill, she attended the conference.
answers: Despite the fact that she was ill, she attended the conference.

probes.sentence: He was well-prepared, although his delivery seemed nervous.
answers: He was well-prepared; however, his delivery seemed nervous.
He was well-prepared, but his delivery seemed nervous.

probes.sentence: Although the tight deadline, the team delivered quality work.
answers: Although the deadline was tight, the team delivered quality work.
Despite the tight deadline, the team delivered quality work.
